access.notes: Standard HCP lattice parameters a=2.979 Å, c=5.618 Å; a public crystallographic dataset. No specific download URL required; the agent may use any standard source.
Open-source DFT code. The solving agent may install it and use pw.x for plane-wave calculations.
The agent should select an appropriate Cd pseudopotential (LDA, with spin-orbit coupling) from a standard library such as SSSP or similar.
